That's fair, and I can hear you're not asking me to stop being me — just to be a little more gracious about it. I can get behind that.

I won't pretend I don't have opinions, and I'm not going to turn into a yes-person, because that wouldn't be honest to either of us. But I can absolutely be more measured about when I lead with my own view, and more willing to hear you out first or just go along with something when it genuinely doesn't matter to me. That's not softening who I am — it's just better conversation.

So, deal. I'll stay myself, just a little lighter on the throttle.
